subject: Dedicated capacity: post-call recap & pricing next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Turner <sofia.turner@acmeai.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity: post-call recap & pricing next steps

Hi Sofia — great to chat today, thanks for the time. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps: 

Call recap
- Primary workload: conversational search + assistant with 1.5k mean prompt length, occasional 8k bursts.
- Current traffic: ~120k user requests/day, ~200M tokens/day (prompt + completion) with peak 1.2x daily spikes.
- SLO target: p95 latency < 250ms for typical chat generation.
- Need: dedicated GPU pool with predictable throughput, private tenancy preferred but open to dedicated-hosted.

Pricing & budget signals (from call)
- Target unit economics: ~$1,000 per 1M tokens target initially (want to validate with full dedicated config).
- Budget range: $70k–$120k/month committed for the right SLA and throughput guarantees.

Immediate next steps
1) We'll send a preliminary pricing range for 3 reserved configs (8x A100, 16x A100, 8x H100-equivalent) with estimated throughput and expected $/1M tokens.
2) Marcus to confirm throughput targets and mapping from your qps/seq-lens to GPU sizing.
3) Sofia to share procurement timeline and any mandatory security questionnaires.

I'll attach a short proposal and SLA draft for your review — open to scheduling a follow-up next week to walk the numbers.

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0134
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RI_Proposal_ACME_20280415.pdf (proposal), SLA_Draft_ACME_20280415.docx (SLA draft)

From: Sofia Turner <sofia.turner@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmeai.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmeai.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: post-call recap & pricing next steps

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and aligns with what I captured. A couple clarifications so your configs are accurate: 

- Token volumes: 200M tokens/day is current average. We expect 25% YoY growth; for sizing please model 300M/day as a 12‑month forecast.
- Sequence lengths: ~85% of requests are <2k tokens. ~10% are 2k–4k. ~5% are >4k (these are often long-text syntheses).
- Peak concurrency: during business hours we hit sustained 2200 concurrent requests; spikes up to 3k QPS for short bursts (30–90s).
- Budget: procurement has an initial approved range of $80k–$100k/month; if committed for 12 months with predictable pricing we can stretch to $120k.
- Procurement timeline: we start paperwork mid-May; target go-live by July 1.

Please include test/validation windows and any performance credits in the proposal. We'll also need SOC2 evidence, but procurement will follow up officially.

Sofia
Sofia Turner | Head of Platform
Acme AI
sofia.turner@acmeai.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: GPU sizing & throughput mapping for Acme

Marissa / Rishi — notes from Sofia's clarifications below. High-level mapping and questions for pricing: 

Workload sizing assumptions (12-month forecast 300M tokens/day):
- Target average tokens/sec: ~3,472 tokens/sec sustained (300M / 86400). Peak sustained (business hours) ~1.5x = 5,200 tokens/sec.
- For conversational loads with 1.5k median sequence length we should size for latency SLO on H100-class GPUs or dense A100 80GB with optimized batching.

Prelim configs to quote: 
A) 8x A100-80GB (reserved) — expected sustained throughput: ~40 tok/s per GPU for our generation stack at 1.5k avg -> ~320 tok/s total. This seems off for their numbers; need to confirm model and perf numbers.
B) 16x A100-80GB — ~640 tok/s total.
C) 8x H100-equivalent (or 8x H100) — ~90 tok/s per GPU -> ~720 tok/s total.

Questions: 
1) Sofia mentioned 3k QPS spikes — is that QPS (requests/sec) or concurrent users? Need to map requests -> token output.
2) Which model family will they pin? LLM architecture choice (open Llama variant vs Mistral vs other) changes per-GPU token/sec drastically.

For proposal we should present 3 tiers with expected $/1M tokens and estimated headroom. I'll run perf with our benchmarking harness and confirm numbers by EOD tomorrow.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin | Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Turner <sofia.turner@acmeai.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Apr 2028 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: post-call recap & pricing next steps

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the perf check. Sofia — attaching the proposal & SLA draft (see attachments). High-level pricing ranges (ballpark, will refine after perf numbers):

Tier 1 — Small reserved pool
- Config: 8x A100-80GB reserved
- Committed throughput estimate: 300–400 tok/s total (sustained)
- Estimated monthly list price: $65k–$80k
- Estimated $/1M tokens: $900–$1,100

Tier 2 — Mid reserved pool
- Config: 16x A100-80GB reserved
- Committed throughput estimate: 600–750 tok/s total
- Estimated monthly list price: $110k–$140k
- Estimated $/1M tokens: $600–$900 (economies of scale + higher utilization)

Tier 3 — H100-optimized pool
- Config: 8x H100 (or equivalent) reserved
- Committed throughput estimate: 700–900 tok/s total
- Estimated monthly list price: $140k–$180k
- Estimated $/1M tokens: $500–$750

Notes & assumptions:
- These are host-level costs and include our optimized runtime, batching, and KV caching. Final $/1M tokens depends on model, quantization, and effective cache hit rate.
- We can offer stepped discounts for 12-month commitments and a performance runbook during onboarding.
- Proposal includes a 14-day validation window and 99.9% uptime SLA with credits tied to p95 latency targets.

Next steps: 
- Marcus to confirm perf numbers for their target model (will follow-up with bench results).
- Sofia to confirm preferred tier and procurement timeline so we can prepare an order form & refined pricing.

I'll follow up with an itemized pricing worksheet once Marcus shares the validated throughput numbers.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: RI_Proposal_ACME_20280415.pdf, SLA_Draft_ACME_20280415.docx

From: Sofia Turner <sofia.turner@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmeai.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmeai.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Apr 2028 11:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity: post-call recap & pricing next steps

Marissa / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear tiers. Procurement will review the proposal this week. A couple quick asks before we lock a tier: 

- Can you confirm the expected $/1M tokens assuming our 12-month forecast (300M/day) for each tier? Please show a simple worked example (monthly tokens -> monthly cost -> $/1M tokens) so procurement can justify the math.
- For Tier 2 and Tier 3, can you confirm whether we get any free credits for the validation window and how many hours the validation runs require (we want to include the validation in our timeline).
- SOC2 evidence: procurement asked for the SOC2 type II report and contact for security questions.

If those items are in the proposal/SLA we can move to procurement review; I'll aim to confirm preferred tier by 2028-04-22.

Regards,
Sofia
